ms.promise:
Objectives: 
・ The Project team will produce an analysis of each WG and the outcomes will be used to inform the strategic scope of future Catalyst funding rounds 
・ A virtual workshop will be set up by the Project Team and working group hosts to discuss the outcomes of the events

Deliverables will include: 
・ Draft of a research report that collates and synthesizes working group data 
・ Set of consolidated recommendations that are potentially implementable by the Catalyst Team for F13 
・ Storyboard for video production materials
・ Workshop to communicate preliminary research outputs

1. Insights have been collated from each working group
2. Recommendations are for changes that could be made to Catalyst Fund13 without disruption of services. The Catalyst team will be able to provide commentary on the feasibility of implementation for recommended changes.
3. The storyboard can be handed off to video resources for final production
4. The workshop has taken place and was recorded
